sql: SELECT 'policy' AS k, tablename || ' | ' || policyname || ' | ' || cmd || ' | ' || coalesce(qual, '') AS txt FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename IN ('wapi_messages','campaign_leads','wapi_conversations','companies','lead_history','company_events') AND cmd IN ('SELECT','ALL') UNION ALL SELECT 'index', tablename || ' | ' || indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename IN ('wapi_messages','campaign_leads','wapi_conversations') UNION ALL SELECT 'fn', p.proname || ' | ' || pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('is_admin','user_has_company_access','get_user_company_ids','has_company_access') UNION ALL SELECT 'rows', relname || ' | ' || reltuples::bigint FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN ('wapi_messages','campaign_leads','wapi_conversations','lead_history') UNION ALL SELECT 'timeout', current_setting('statement_timeout') UNION ALL SELECT 'cfg', r.rolname || ' | ' || array_to_string(r.rolconfig, ',') FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('authenticated','anon','authenticator')
